case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

number_of_accused.reason: Judgment refers to the sole appellant accused.

accused_gender.reason: Accused is referred to with male pronouns throughout.

accused_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for the accused.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of the accused is not mentioned.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of the accused is not mentioned.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Only the witness PW-11's labour-class status is mentioned, not the accused's.

previous_criminal_record.reason: Only past misbehaviour toward PW-11 is mentioned, not a criminal record.

victim_gender.reason: Victim Devi is referred to as female.

victim_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for the victim.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Known to the victim's family; prior dealings and inimical relationship with them
accused_victim_relationship.quote: It is not the case of the appellant that there was no previous contact in any manner whatsoever
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment shows prior contact and inimical relations with the victim's family, not a stranger.

offence_category.quote: committing rape and murder of one Devi
offence_category.reason: Category omits rape, which was also charged and upheld.

weapon.correct_value: Blue shawl (apparently used for strangulation); no weapon expressly identified
weapon.quote: whose neck was wrapped with a blue shawl owned by her
weapon.reason: Judgment does not call it a weapon, but the shawl around the neck relates to the strangulation.

evidence_type.reason: Judgment states it was a case of circumstantial evidence.

confession.reason: No confession is mentioned; accused only made a simple denial under s.313.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: no missing link in any of the circumstances found proved against the appellant
aggravating_circumstances.reason: These are incriminating circumstances, not sentencing aggravating factors, which the judgment does not state.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted and sentenced to life and 10 years RI.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Conviction and sentence confirmed by the High Court
high_court_outcome.quote: which was also confirmed by the High Court
high_court_outcome.reason: Judgment states the High Court confirmed the conviction and sentence.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, so conviction stands.

offence_finally_established.reason: Conviction for murder and rape was upheld.

imprisonment_type.correct_value: Rigorous imprisonment for life (s.302) and 10 years rigorous imprisonment (s.376)
imprisonment_type.quote: rigorous imprisonment for life and 10 years rigorous imprisonment
imprisonment_type.reason: Value gives only life, omitting the 10-year rigorous imprisonment for rape.

imprisonment_years.correct_value: 10 years rigorous imprisonment (s.376); life imprisonment for s.302
imprisonment_years.quote: 10 years rigorous imprisonment for committing rape and murder
imprisonment_years.reason: Null omits the stated 10-year term for rape.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned in the judgment.

neutral_facts.correct_value: A neutral summary of the facts without stating the conviction, e.g. the accused was produced by police on 21.2.2005 after being absent from the village.
neutral_facts.quote: the appellant was produced before the investigating officer by Jagmal Singh only on 21.2.2005 when he was arrested
neutral_facts.reason: States the conviction, revealing the outcome, and wrongly says accused was not present during investigation.

offence_severity.reason: Statutory punishment ranges are not in the judgment and rely on outside knowledge.

attempt_completion.reason: Rape and murder were completed; the victim died.

physical_harm.reason: Judgment mentions intercourse, asphyxia from strangulation, and contusions and abrasions.

number_of_offences.reason: Two offences under ss.302 and 376 were charged and the conviction upheld.

financial_property_loss.reason: No property loss is mentioned, so 'not applicable' is substantively accurate.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Not stated (the court found motive based on past grudge, not premeditation)
premeditation_planning.quote: one day or other he would take a revenge for the said incident
premeditation_planning.reason: Judgment never finds premeditation or planning; it relies on motive and grudge.

motive.reason: Past misbehaviour, Panchayat apology and resulting grudge match the judgment.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Medical evidence of intercourse and PW-10's testimony on accused's presence were accepted.

witness_credibility.reason: Court found PW-10 and PW-11 corroborated each other and that variations were immaterial.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Accused ran away without answering PW-10 and remained absent for two days.

custody_duration.reason: Length of custody is not stated.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence: 18.2.2005; High Court judgment: 07.09.2011; Supreme Court decision: April 11, 2013; trial court judgment date not stated
trial_duration.quote: Judgment and Order dated 07.09.2011 of the High Court of Punjab and Haryana
trial_duration.reason: The 07.09.2011 date is the High Court order, not the trial judgment.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for appellant and respondent match the judgment.

investigation_status.correct_value: Trial completed; accused arrested 21.2.2005; FIR registration and charge sheet not stated
investigation_status.quote: On reaching the spot PW-14, SHO recorded the statement
investigation_status.reason: FIR registration and charge sheet filing are not mentioned in the judgment.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity is noted; defence variation argument was rejected as immaterial.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court: convicted and sentenced; High Court: conviction and sentence confirmed; Supreme Court: appeal dismissed
appeal_history.quote: which was also confirmed by the High Court
appeal_history.reason: Trial court entry wrongly says conviction was confirmed rather than the accused being convicted.

prosecution_argument.reason: Matches the prosecution case on presence, flight, absconding and inimical relations.

defence_argument.reason: Accused claimed false implication due to inimical relations and led no defence evidence.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Court found no missing link in the circumstances, consistent with the chain-of-circumstances principle.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: No precedent is cited in the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.correct_value: Not stated as a separate sentencing rationale; court held conviction and sentence perfectly justified on the evidence
sentencing_rationale.quote: the conviction and sentence imposed on the appellant ... was perfectly justified
sentencing_rationale.reason: Judgment gives reasons for conviction and motive, not separate sentencing reasons.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: No mitigating factors are discussed by the court.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: No aggravating factors are discussed by the court.
